text:
The independent JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 map identifies **98% of the 81.3 ha loss area as forest in 2020**, supporting the pre-loss forest baseline.

Uruguay’s 2021 national forest map provides further context: it maps **68.1 ha** of the event area as planted pine forest, **0 ha** as native forest, and **13.2 ha** outside mapped forest.

The annual series also includes observations after the 2021 event, through 2025. Together with the JRC agreement, this meets the tool’s corroboration rule. The JRC and national maps support the forest baseline and type; they do not independently establish the timing or cause of the loss.
